paraphrase_notes: Supports limiting the interpretation of one assessment or observed performance to the evidence actually collected rather than inferring broader competence from a narrower observation.
applicability_notes: The testing standard supports restrained score/evidence interpretation; it does not itself define employer authorization. The broader authorization boundary remains a Crew Blueprint framework and employer-controlled state.
required_qualifier: Observed performance on one named task/context does not by itself establish broader employer authorization or specialist qualification.
